answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 36233 Country: India Title: Please tell me about Maulana Fateh Muhammad Jalandhari Question: Please tell me about Maulana Fateh Muhammad Jalandhari. From which maslak did he belong? I want to read his Quran translation. Is it right to read his translation? Answer ID: 36233 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 246/148/D=1433) Maulana Fateh Muhammad Jalandhari is among Ulama-e-Haq. He is indirect disciple of Shah Ishaque (رحمة الله عليه). His Urdu translation and Tafseer is authentic. You can read it. However, if during your study you are unable to understand any thing or you have any objection mark it with a pencil and consult any Alim so that you could be saved from any mistake in understanding the holy Quran and what you understand is free from doubts. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
